programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: A stunning snake goddess in human form seduces a young scholar before a Buddhist monk breaks up their union.

programme.title: The New One-Armed Swordsman
programme.desc: A swordsman (David Chiang) is moved to fight back after the love of his life is kidnapped and his best friend murdered by a gang.

programme.title: Hong Kong Rhapsody
programme.desc: A follow-up to the previous blockbuster, this 60's musical features an unemployed magician whose love life is as twisted as his tricks.

programme.title: Men From the Monastery
programme.desc: The story of Shaolin firebrands Fang Shih-yu, Hung I-kuan, and Hu Huei-chien comes to life in Chang Cheh's rousing kung fu saga.

programme.title: The House of 72 Tenants
programme.desc: This fascinating, humorous box office smash captures a cross-section of Hong Kong society and their issues -- all crammed into a single tenement building.

programme.title: Clan Feuds
programme.desc: Adapted from a book by Ku Lung, this spectacular martial arts showcase features an all-star cast including Ti Lung, Lo Mang, Ai Fei and Lily Li.

programme.title: The Mad Monk Strikes Again
programme.desc: In this sequel, the Mad Monk is joined by immortal scholar-turned-genie, Lu Tung Pin, as they both wreak havoc in an attempt to outdo each other!

programme.title: Swordswomen Three
programme.desc: In this classic, Shen Yi, Essie Lin Chia, and Pan Ying-tzu take on Shaw's first international superstar, Lo Lieh, making this a 4-star treat for action fans.

programme.title: The Blue and the Black
programme.desc: A young couple's love is put to the test over a tumultuous period of Chinese history. Starring Linda Lin Dai, Kwan Shan.

programme.title: Crazy Nuts of Kung Fu
programme.desc: A roadside bandit and a traveling gambler team up to steal a huge amount of money from a warlord's home when they encounter revolutionists who seek their help to fund the reform campaign.

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager's use of the Boxers to remove the foreign powers from China yields unexpected results. Starring Alexander Fu.

programme.title: The Singing Thief
programme.desc: A jewel thief tries to have a new life as a singer but a series of robberies gets people wondering if he has returned to his old ways.

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: In this masterpiece from Li Han Hsiang, sparks fly when minister Cheng Pu decides to marry off his youngest daughter before his eldest one.

programme.title: Ghosts Galore
programme.desc: Young Taoist priest Lu and his friend are saved by Master Lian during a botched exorcism and they beseech him to teach them. Then his friend is killed and with his master's help, Lu avenges him.

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: This heartwarming 1963 musical from Shaw Brothers tells the tale of a beautiful shepherdess, whose own problems drag her into a love triangle.

programme.title: Heroes of the East
programme.desc: Trouble ensues after Ah To (Gordon Liu) marries a Japanese martial artist (Yuka Mizuno) and has a need to prove his martial prowess.

programme.title: Between Tears and Smiles
programme.desc: The Shaw Brothers' directors created this 60's classic depicting a timeless romance between a wealthy man and a songbird.

programme.title: Little Hero
programme.desc: Dubbed Little Bastard due to never having known his parents, a young man seeks his roots, with help from a staunch ally called Little Beggar.

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: Cheng Pei Pei stars as Hsiao-Yun, a young singer struggling to juggle her career and her relationship with her pianist lover.

programme.title: The Rescue
programme.desc: Daring Sung Dynasty must fight their way out of trap after trap and band together to save the prime minister.

programme.title: Asia-pol

programme.title: Dawn Will Come
programme.desc: In true Huangmei opera style, lovely Li Hsiang-chun stars as a used and abused beauty in director Kao Li's restrained, as well as sadistic tearjerker.

programme.title: The New Shaolin Boxers
programme.desc: Alexander Fu stars as a young carriage driver who finds love and encounters peril after he rescues a girl from being harassed by a dangerous group.

programme.title: Empress Wu

programme.title: Secret Service of the Imperial Court
programme.desc: A secret service agent, Chao Pu Fun, must protect the innocent against a power-mad Eunuch.

programme.title: The Merry Wife
programme.desc: Jealousy threatens to expose the secret relationship of a 17-year-old student and her 35-year-old teacher husband.

programme.title: The 36th Chamber of Shaolin
programme.desc: Winner of Best Martial Arts Award at the 1978 Asian Film Festival, this piece is directed by Liu Chia-liang and features his brother, Gordon, as a martial arts master.

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: A cruel uncle stands in the way between a young scholar and the beautiful gal with whom he falls in love, and happiness.

programme.title: Angel With the Iron Fists
programme.desc: After her father is killed by gangsters, a young woman seeks revenge plus bids to ensure that justice is served. Starring Lily Ho.

programme.title: The Younger Generation
programme.desc: After a young mother and her husband die, one child is sold into prostitution to feed the other four.

programme.title: Shaolin Intruders

programme.title: The Story of Sue San
programme.desc: This compelling Shaw Brothers Huangmei Opera depicts the romance of star-crossed lovers the son of a respected government official and a famed prostitute.

programme.title: The Invincible Fist
programme.desc: A village's dedicated chief constable falls in love with the blind daughter of a havoc-wreaking bandit.

programme.title: The Pearl Phoenix
programme.desc: This gender-bending tale depicts the romance between a wealthy girl and a man disguised as a flunkey in order to be employed at her house.

programme.title: The Imperial Tomb Raiders
programme.desc: The story revolves around a maverick, a band of female warriors and a group of ruthless bandits who teams up to raid the emperor's tomb. Will they be successful?

programme.title: Drive
programme.desc: Yuna is a YouTuber who is invited to a party where she drinks and falls asleep. She is then trapped in the trunk. The kidnapper asks her to do a kidnap live-stream and beg for money...

programme.title: The Attorney
programme.desc: When tax attorney Song Woo-Suk agrees to defend a student activist who was arrested and tortured into giving a false confession, his entire life and worldview begin to change drastically.

programme.title: Love My Scent
programme.desc: After wearing a perfume he receives from a stranger, Chang-Soo earns the ability to attract every woman in the world. Ara begins to sense the scent of Chang-Soo and falls in love with him.

programme.title: Switch
programme.desc: The life of a top star actor was turned upside down when he meets a taxi driver on Christmas Eve.

programme.title: Pilot
programme.desc: Han Jung-woo is a popular star pilot. He is unable to work in any company due to a momentary mistake. He later gets a job his sister's identity. But his new job is soon threatened...

programme.title: Midnight Runners
programme.desc: Two students from Korean National Police University decide to work together and track down a kidnapping incident.

programme.title: I Don't Fire Myself
programme.desc: Being discriminated as a woman, Jeong-eun was dispatched and given great pressure to resign, but she is not willing to simply give up...

programme.title: Waiting for Rain
programme.desc: An unmotivated student regains his passion for life after exchanging letters with his childhood friend and promise to meet if it rains on December 31st each year.

programme.title: 200 Pounds Beauty
programme.desc: A timid, overweight and under-appreciated back-up singer resorts to drastic 'head-to-toe' plastic surgery to become a pop diva.

programme.title: Hot Young Bloods
programme.desc: In a rural town in 1982, a tough young girl secretly has a crush on a playboy. When a transfer student arrives, the playboy falls in love with her causing unexpected chaos at school.

programme.title: Missing You
programme.desc: When Hee-Joo was 7 years old, her father was murdered. The killer, Ki-Bum, was eventually arrested. Hee-Joo has waited patiently for Ki-Bum's release.

programme.title: Pop Paper City S1 Ep45
programme.desc: On today's poptastic adventure, Hooper and Fly are making a spectacular jelly cake. But when Hooper tries to do too much too quickly, will the cake hold together?

programme.title: Messy Goes to OKIDO S1 Ep23
programme.desc: Messy has to save OKIDO from a falling comet before his bedtime! He sees that Mayor Oki still has his bath!

programme.title: Bluey S3 Ep7
programme.desc: Bluey can't get to sleep, so Mum reads her one last story.

programme.title: Bluey S3 Ep6
programme.desc: Dad complains about how dissimilar Bluey and Bingo are.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S5 Ep6
programme.desc: 'Why do my feet hurt?', Tag asks Duggee. While Duggee has a think, he tells them 'why' is a great question, and the Squirrels are quick to follow up.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S5 Ep5
programme.desc: Duggee is encouraging the Squirrels to come outside by gesturing through the window. They don't understand what he's doing and think it's funny. When he comes inside, he explains that he was miming.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S1 Ep1
programme.desc: At Squirrel Club, Detective Puppy solves the mystery of a missing biscuit, the Rabbits tell us what's cool, and the Squirrels help Delivery Chipmunk with a huge parcel.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S1 Ep6

programme.title: Go Jetters S2 Ep22
programme.desc: Glitch causes chaos at the academy when he loses control of his new biogas boosters.

programme.title: Bluey S1 Ep18
programme.desc: Honey is stuck waiting for Dr Bingo's as the other injuries get seen before her. Receptionist Bluey tells her to be patient, some of these cases are a real pickle!

programme.title: Bluey S1 Ep17
programme.desc: At school, Bluey and her friends enjoy various games. Teacher Calypso keeps her charges on track with a wise word and a song... all except the mysterious Pretzel.

programme.title: Andy's Baby Animal Missions S1 Ep15
programme.desc: In this episode, Andy, Jen and Scout head to Alaska, America on a baby animal mission to help rescue some black bear cubs high up in a tree. Along the way, Andy meets a grumpy Arctic ground squirrel.

programme.title: Dog Squad S2 Ep6
programme.desc: Sylvie the therapy dog has a bit of a sniffle, so they go to see the vet. It's usually Sylvie's job to help others feel calm, but now she needs to help herself stop worrying and also help her owner.

programme.title: Aneeshwar and Lizzie Go Wild S2 Ep6
programme.desc: This episode features the Galapagos tortoise and the giant African land snail - their wild connection is they carry their homes with them.

programme.title: Swashbuckle S8 Ep16
programme.desc: In this episode Seaweed starts to daydream about the Swashbuckle Seven Seas.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S4 Ep20
programme.desc: As Peggee and the Hummingbirds journey up the river to deliver a parcel, they have fun spotting and avoiding the wildlife that they meet along the way.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S4 Ep19
programme.desc: Chipmunk is cycling one day delivering his packages when he hits a rock and his trike falls apart! He has so many packages to deliver - what is he going to do now?

programme.title: Hey Duggee S4 Ep18
